_comment: ClientFence tables (Service::tables(); mod_clientfence_* or a name in Service::HOME_TABLES). New installs create them from install/sql/structure.sql, which must match; Service::ensureTables() makes a missing one. ClientFence core patch: register ticket secrets and audit events. ClientFence core patch: register client Support PINs. ClientFence core patch: registrar costs for the TLD price import.

tables.promo_option: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `promo_option` (`promo_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `include_options` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`promo_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.client_order_upgrade_option: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `client_order_upgrade_option` (`upgrade_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL, `from_options` text NOT NULL, `to_options` text NOT NULL, `to_option_lines` text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`upgrade_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.client_contact: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `client_contact` (`id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `client_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `first_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `last_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `company` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `phone_cc` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `phone` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `address_1` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `address_2` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `city` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `state` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `postcode` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `country` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `tax_id` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `emails` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `created_at` datetime NOT NULL, `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `client_id` (`client_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.product_currency_price: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `product_currency_price` (`id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `kind` varchar(20) NOT NULL, `ref_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `currency` varchar(3) NOT NULL, `period` varchar(10) NOT NULL, `price` decimal(18,2) DEFAULT NULL, `setup_price` decimal(18,2) DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` datetime NOT NULL, `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `item_currency_period` (`kind`, `ref_id`, `currency`, `period`), KEY `currency` (`currency`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.email_template_translation: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `email_template_translation` (`id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `email_template_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `lang` varchar(10) NOT NULL, `subject` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `content` mediumtext NOT NULL, `created_at` datetime NOT NULL, `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `template_lang` (`email_template_id`, `lang`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.product_translation: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `product_translation` (`id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `kind` varchar(20) NOT NULL, `ref_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `lang` varchar(10) NOT NULL, `title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `description` mediumtext DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` datetime NOT NULL, `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `item_lang` (`kind`, `ref_id`, `lang`), KEY `lang` (`lang`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.service_license_log: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `service_license_log` (`id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `service_license_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `host` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `ip` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `path` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `version` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `result` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `created_at` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `license_date` (`service_license_id`, `created_at`), KEY `created_at` (`created_at`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
tables.service_license_ban: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `service_license_ban` (`id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `value` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `notes` text NOT NULL, `created_at` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `value` (`value`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
tables.mod_clientfence_import_map: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mod_clientfence_import_map` (`source` varchar(20) NOT NULL, `entity` varchar(30) NOT NULL, `source_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `target_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `created_at` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`source`, `entity`, `source_id`), KEY `target` (`entity`, `target_id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.mod_clientfence_import_warning: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mod_clientfence_import_warning` (`id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `source` varchar(20) NOT NULL, `step` varchar(30) NOT NULL, `message` text NOT NULL, `created_at` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `source` (`source`, `id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.mod_clientfence_notification: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mod_clientfence_notification` (`id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `audience` varchar(10) NOT NULL, `recipient_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `kind` varchar(40) NOT NULL, `params` text NOT NULL, `url` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `dedupe` varchar(120) DEFAULT NULL, `created_at` datetime NOT NULL, `read_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `dedupe` (`audience`, `recipient_id`, `dedupe`), KEY `recipient` (`audience`, `recipient_id`, `read_at`, `id`), KEY `created` (`created_at`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.tld_registrar_cost: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tld_registrar_cost` (`id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `tld_registrar_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL, `tld` varchar(64) NOT NULL, `currency` char(3) NOT NULL, `cost_register` decimal(18,4) DEFAULT NULL, `cost_renew` decimal(18,4) DEFAULT NULL, `cost_transfer` decimal(18,4) DEFAULT NULL, `applied_register` decimal(18,4) DEFAULT NULL, `applied_renew` decimal(18,4) DEFAULT NULL, `applied_transfer` decimal(18,4) DEFAULT NULL, `applied_rate` decimal(18,8) DEFAULT NULL, `fetched_at` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `tld_registrar_cost_tld` (`tld_registrar_id`, `tld`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
